d: Job Summary: Responsible for leading the organization's financial strategy, governance, risk management, treasury operations, and financial performance. The CFO will partner with the CEO and Board of Directors to drive sustainable growth, profitability, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
MBA preferred; CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or CFA highly preferred.
Minimum 15 years of progressive finance leadership experience, including 7 years in a senior role within financial services.
Proven expertise in global remittances, money exchange, FX trading, gold and bullion trading, treasury, liquidity management, and payments.
Experience dealing with central banks, regulators, correspondent banks, and external auditors.
Strong knowledge of IFRS, corporate finance, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
Note: We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted
r: Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with business objectives.
Advise the CEO and Board on financial performance, planning, growth, investments, and expansion opportunities.
Oversee accounting, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and performance management.
Ensure accurate financial statements, strong internal controls, and financial governance.
Manage treasury operations, liquidity, cash flow, capital allocation, and banking relationships.
Implement funding and hedging strategies to mitigate currency and commodity risks.
Remittance, Money Exchange, Gold & FX Operations
Oversee financial performance, profitability, pricing, and liquidity across remittance, money exchange, FX, and bullion trading operations.
Manage trading risks, transaction valuation, financial reporting, and related business development initiatives.
Establish risk management frameworks and ensure compliance with AML, KYC, CTF, sanctions screening, and regulatory requirements.
Liaise with regulators, central banks, and auditors, overseeing audit activities and corrective actions.
Lead finance, treasury, and accounting teams, fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
Maintain relationships with banks, regulators, investors, and business partners, and present financial recommendations to the Board.

d: As a Collection Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and collecting outstanding receivables from government customers, ensuring timely payments while maintaining strong and professional customer relationships. This role plays a critical part in optimizing cash flow, minimizing financial risk, and supporting the organization's overall financial health. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and customers to resolve payment issues, improve collection performance, and ensure compliance with applicable regulations and company policies.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
2-3 years of experience in collections, accounts receivable, credit control, or a related finance function.
Good understanding of collection principles, accounts receivable processes, and relevant UAE regulations.
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to manage sensitive situations professionally.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar enterprise platforms is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize tasks effectively, and meet deadlines.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to accuracy.
High level of integrity and professionalism in handling confidential financial information.
Fluency in Arabic and English, both written and verbal.

r: Proactively engage with customers regarding overdue payments through phone calls, emails, and written correspondence.
Negotiate payment arrangements and settlement agreements in alignment with company policies and legal requirements.
Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies, billing issues, and customer disputes in a timely and professional manner.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of collection activities, communications, and payment commitments within the company’s systems.
Monitor customer accounts to identify potential credit risks and recommend appropriate actions to minimize exposure.
Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service, and Finance teams to address collection challenges and improve operational processes.
Prepare and maintain regular reports on collection activities, aging accounts, recovery performance, and outstanding balances.
Ensure compliance with relevant collection laws, regulations, and internal policies.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of collection strategies, procedures, and best practices.
Support efforts to improve customer payment behavior and enhance overall accounts receivable performance.
Escalate complex collection issues and high-risk accounts when appropriate to ensure timely resolution.
Maintain professional and positive customer relationships while balancing business objectives and financial controls.

d: Job Title: Manager of Customer / Patient Experience & Administration
Reports To: Senior Sport Medicine Manager

The Customer / Patient Experience & Administration Manager is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end patient journey and all front-of-house and administrative operations across the healthcare organization.
The role ensures exceptional patient experience, efficient administrative processes, and seamless coordination between clinical and operational teams.

Reporting to the Senior Sport Medicine Manager, this position drives service excellence, operational efficiency, and patient-centered culture across registration, call centers, scheduling, billing support, and customer relations.
Design and implement a customer /patient experience strategy aligned with organizational values and quality standards.
Map and optimize the end-to-end customer / patient journey (access, appointment, arrival, clinical screening, treatment, discharge, and follow-up, and digital engagement).
Oversee customer/patient feedback systems, surveys, complaints, and resolution processes.
Oversee all administrative and front-desk functions including registration, scheduling, medical records, call center, and patient coordination.
Ensure efficient services flow, accurate data capture, and timely documentation.
Standardize SOPs for admissions, discharge, referrals, and insurance coordination.
Monitor capacity, waiting times, and service level performance.
Work closely with all the departments and functions to ensure experience is embedded in care delivery.
Ensure consistent experience standards across physicians, therapists, coaches, nurses, and front-line teams.
Lead individual and patient liaison services and manage escalations and complex cases.
Ensure clear, compassionate communication with individuals, patients and families.
Coordinate multilingual services and accessibility support where required.
Develop customer /patient engagement, retention, and loyalty programs.
Lead communication, education, and experience personalization strategies.
Oversee customer /patient communities, athlete support programs, and long-term care relationships.
Ensure administrative processes comply with healthcare regulations, accreditation standards (CBAHI, JCI), and data privacy requirements.
Implement quality assurance audits for patient experience and administrative services.
Collaborate with GRC and Clinical Quality teams on patient rights and safety standards.
Oversee digital touchpoints including appointment systems, customer portals, mobile apps, and CRM platforms.
Drive automation and paperless workflows to improve access, efficiency, and satisfaction.
Define KPIs for customer /patient experience and administration (waiting time, complaints, first-call resolution, no-show rate).
Develop dashboards and reports for the senior sport medicine director and executive leadership.
Use data to drive continuous improvement initiatives.
Lead and develop teams across reception, call center, patient relations, and administrative services.
Ensure training in service excellence, communication, privacy, and healthcare regulations.
Build a culture of empathy, professionalism, and accountability.
Work closely with Medical, Nursing, Finance (RCM), IT, and Marketing teams to ensure a seamless patient journey.
Support service line expansion, new clinic openings, and operational readiness from a patient experience perspective.
Build a patient-centric culture across the organization.
Design and oversee service excellence training for all staff (clinical and non-clinical).
Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or related field.
Master’s degree preferred (MHA, MBA, Service Design, Healthcare Quality).
8+ years of experience in healthcare operations, patient experience, or service excellence roles.
Strong knowledge of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and patient rights.
Proven leadership in customer experience, administration, and service operations.
